description: React Native component for displaying a yearly summary/wrap-up of user statistics in the Notesnook app, including slides for total notes, words, activity, tags, notebooks, attachments, and a summary with share functionality.

classes.name: Slide
classes.description: A simple container component for individual slides with centered content.

classes.name: WelcomeSlide
classes.description: Introductory slide welcoming the user to their yearly wrap-up.

classes.name: TotalNotesSlide
classes.description: Displays total notes created in the year.

classes.name: TotalWordsSlide
classes.description: Displays total words written in the year.

classes.name: ActivityStatsSlide
classes.description: Shows most notes created in a month and day.

classes.name: AttachmentsSlide
classes.description: Displays total attachments and storage used.

classes.name: SummarySlide
classes.description: Provides a detailed summary with charts and stats, including share functionality.

methods.name: formatNumber
methods.description: Formats a number into a more readable string with suffixes like K or M.
